protocol.user_correction: Inspect short-budget evidence before deciding whether long training is justified; pause unnecessary methods and seeds.
protocol.why_seeds: Seed1 is an original high performer, seed2 is the previously weak seed. This is a diagnostic screen, not an unbiased final replication.

decision_policy.freeze_before_results: No automatic three-epoch continuation; record an evidence-based method decision after the complete screen.
decision_policy.promising: Prefer a method if paired P0 improves by>=5pp on both diagnostic seeds, or materially rescues the weak seed without>5pp loss on the stronger seed, and generation/counterfactual evidence does not clearly contradict it. Continue at most one or two interpretable directions to a second stage.
decision_policy.stop: Defer a method with>=10pp paired P0 regression on both seeds and no compensating action/generation signal; independently confirmed collapse/numerical failures stop immediately.
decision_policy.ambiguous: Report inconclusive; only a limited second-stage run is justified by improving task trajectories or a specific diagnostic. A weak one-epoch result is not universal disproof.
decision_policy.seeds3_4: Keep their full state paused until a method earns further testing; no duplicate fresh seed launches.

protocol.evaluation_limits: Small fixed diagnostic samples are for screening. FVD64 is not a final-quality claim. These seeds and cases are not independent final confirmation.
protocol.publication: Commit and push informative short-budget results, including negative/inconclusive outcomes, full per-case numbers, runtime costs and scientific figures.

early_health_policy.user_instruction: Inspect approximate10minute short-run health before long experiments.
early_health_policy.past_execution_gap: The original200step smoke covered numerics/execution; a10minute checkpoint was not saved. Historical metrics can be inspected, but a retrospective10minute functional audit cannot be claimed.
early_health_policy.future_experiments: Run and save a roughly600update(~10min) stage first, inspect finite loss/gradients, state response and quick same-reset predictions before longer stages. If early semantic use is not learned, record inconclusive and require trend/context evidence rather than calling it a failed method.
early_health_policy.stop_immediately: NaN/Inf, OOM, broken action/state gradient paths, constant outputs insensitive to state after sustained opportunity to learn; preserve checkpoints.
early_health_policy.avoid_false_collapse: Small initial state variance or poor early P0 alone cannot establish persistent collapse; the original useful model also learns late.

limits: Training seeds1/2 were selected for diagnosis; this is not final cross-seed confirmation.
All checkpoints are exactly12491updates under the original124910step LR schedule.
Two evaluation seeds are test conditions, not two extra training seeds.
FVD64 and16counterfactual cases are diagnostic; no full generation gate or benchmark claim.
Weak early results can be inconclusive; stop/continue must use task evidence, trajectories and cost.
No human gallery signoff or improvement in model-size-matched final performance is inferred.
